how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online at www.sssc.uk.gov.in between 14 September 2026 and 14 October 2026. The application process involves five steps as laid out in the notification:
Registration & Personal Details: Register using your Aadhaar number (each Aadhaar number can be used only once) along with your own mobile number and email ID.
Educational & Other Details: Fill in educational qualification, category, and other required details.

Upload Photo, Signature, and Biometric Details: Upload a recent scanned colour passport-size photograph (150w×200H px), signature (150w×100H px), and a scan of the left thumb impression (150w×100H px) in JPG/JPEG format, along with the High School certificate and both sides of the Aadhaar card, plus category/reservation and experience certificates where applicable.
Make Payment: Pay the application fee online via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
Print Application: Download and keep a printout of the completed application for personal records; it does not need to be sent to the Commission.
important_instructions: Only one online application is permitted per advertised post; multiple applications for the same post will all be rejected. Applicants must ensure they meet all essential and preferential eligibility conditions by the application closing date; incomplete or ineligible applications will be rejected even after provisional admission to the exam. A one-time edit facility will be provided after the application closing date, but the name, parents' name, date of birth, and exam centre cannot be changed during this edit. Admit cards will not be sent by post; they must be downloaded from the official website. Application fee once paid is non-refundable and non-adjustable if the application is later cancelled and re-submitted. Mobile phones, calculators, cameras, pagers, scanner pens, or any other electronic device are prohibited inside the examination centre. The provisional answer key will be published on the website after the exam; objections can be raised within the stipulated time on payment of ₹50 per question, submitted online. Any use of unfair means during the examination is punishable under the Uttarakhand Competitive Examinations (Measures for Prevention and Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2023. Candidates should regularly check the official website for updates on the exam schedule, admit card, and other notices.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 101 posts are on offer across 19 department-wise categories. Personal Assistant posts account for 94 of these vacancies, while Stenographer, Stenographer Grade-3, and Stenographer Grade-2 posts together account for the remaining 7. Note on the source document: In the department-wise detailed tables of the official notification, the block covering rows 8–18 above (57 posts in total) is headed "Junior Assistant" (कनिष्ठ सहायक) in the section title, while every individual row inside that table lists the post name as "Personal Assistant." This inconsistency exists in the original notification. Candidates should cross-check the exact post code and department name for their preferred vacancy directly against the official PDF before applying. The 22 posts under the Housing Department (row 19) are further split across district-level Development Authorities including Almora, Bageshwar, Chamoli, Champawat, Mussoorie-Dehradun, Haridwar-Roorkee, Nainital, Pauri, Pithoragarh, Rudraprayag, Tehri, Udham Singh Nagar, Uttarkashi, and the Dehradun Housing & Urban Development Authority.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements differ by post, mainly in the required shorthand and typing speed and, in a few cases, whether a degree is compulsory. The core requirements as given in the notification are summarised below. Preferential (not compulsory) qualifications mentioned for most Personal Assistant and Stenographer posts (other things being equal): a minimum of 2 years' service in the Territorial Army, an NCC "B" or "C" certificate, or a Graduate/Postgraduate degree. For Group 'C' posts recruited outside the purview of the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission, a candidate must satisfy at least one of the following as stated in the notification: registration at an Uttarakhand Sewayojan (Employment) Office before the application closing date; holding an Uttarakhand domicile/permanent residence certificate; or having passed both High School and Intermediate (or equivalent) from institutions located in and recognised by Uttarakhand. Certain relaxations to the Sewayojan registration condition apply to candidates already serving in government or public-sector jobs, as detailed in the notification. Applicants must be citizens of India, or Tibetan refugees who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling here, or persons of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries (Kenya, Uganda, and the former Tanganyika/Zanzibar, now Tanzania) with the intention of permanently settling in India, subject to obtaining the requisite eligibility certificate from the State Government. As per the notification, vertical reservation applicable is: Scheduled Caste (SC) 19%, Scheduled Tribe (ST) 4%, Other Backward Class (OBC) 14%, and Economically Weaker Section (EWS) 10% of total posts. Horizontal reservation includes: Women 30%, Ex-servicemen 5%, Dependents of Freedom Fighters 2%, Orphans 5%, Skilled Sportspersons 4%, Divyang/PwD candidates 4%, and Uttarakhand State Andolankari (identified state-movement agitators) or their dependents 10%. The final reserved/unreserved break-up for each post depends on the roster provided by the respective recruiting department.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted in two stages: Written Competitive Examination: An objective-type (multiple-choice) offline exam of 100 marks and 2 hours' duration, covering the syllabus related to the educational qualification of the post. This exam determines the merit list. Qualifying Typing and Shorthand/Dictation Test: Based on merit in the written exam, candidates numbering up to 4 times the number of vacancies are shortlisted for a qualifying typing test and shorthand/dictation test. This stage is qualifying in nature only - marks from this stage are not added to the final merit. Minimum qualifying marks in the written exam are 45% for Unreserved, EWS, and OBC category candidates, and 35% for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe category candidates; candidates scoring below this are treated as not qualified. Each wrong answer attracts a negative mark of one-fourth of the marks allotted to that question, while unattempted questions carry no negative marking. Marking more than one option for a question is treated as a wrong answer. The final merit/selection list is prepared based on written exam marks, subject to qualifying the typing/shorthand stage; in case of a tie, older candidates are placed higher, and if age is also equal, English alphabetical order of name is used as the tie-breaker.

faq.question: Q1. What is UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission, under Advertisement No. 81/UOSSC/CHA/2026 dated 8 September 2026, to fill 101 Group 'C' posts of Personal Assistant, Stenographer, Stenographer Grade-3, and Stenographer Grade-2 across various Uttarakhand government departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 101 posts are available, comprising 94 Personal Assistant posts and 7 Stenographer/Stenographer Grade posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer posts?
faq.answer: Most posts require Intermediate (12th) pass with a specified Hindi shorthand and typing speed; Stenographer Grade-3 requires a graduate degree with higher shorthand/typing speed requirements. Exact requirements vary by post - see the Qualification section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years for most posts (21 years for two specific posts), and the maximum age is 42 years, calculated as on 1 July 2026, with age relaxation available for reserved categories as per government orders.

faq.question: Q6. What is the UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer application fee?
faq.answer: ₹300 for Unreserved/OBC candidates, ₹150 for SC/ST/EWS and Divyang candidates, and no fee for Orphan candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online at sssc.uk.gov.in between 14 September 2026 and 14 October 2026, following the five-step process described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the UKSSSC selection process?
faq.answer: Selection involves a written objective-type competitive examination, followed by a qualifying typing and shorthand/dictation test for shortlisted candidates, as explained in the Selection Process section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer posts?
faq.answer: Salary ranges from ₹25,500–₹81,100 (Level-04) to ₹44,900–₹1,42,400 (Level-07) depending on the specific post, as detailed in the Salary section above.
